content:
Clara (CS): heads-up  Verdant renewal. customer wants to switch from annual PO to card + shorter term (9mo). procurement asking for signed amendment + vendor code + VAT cert. looping @Ibrahim @Nora @Diego
Ibrahim (Sales): buyer says card is fastest. they can eSign a one-line amendment agreeing to 9mo and will upload PO after legal review. provided provisional vendor id 'VER-INT-5' but finance flagged mismatch.
Nora (Legal): we can accept eSign amendment + CC for first invoice if buyer commits to provide signed PO and VAT cert within 14 days. i'll draft a 2-sentence addendum: commitment + delivery timeframe.
Diego (Ops): ops needs exact legal entity name, billing email, and SOW. we can provision seats on successful card charge but will set account to "pending compliance" and withhold production keys until SOW is attached.
Clara (CS): buyer DM paste:
```
Amendment request: 9 months term, 120 seats
Bill To: Verdant Solutions Ltd (UK)
Total (9mo): GBP 16,200
Billing contact: ap@verdant.co.uk
Vendor ID: VER-INT-5 (provisional)
```
finance-bot: draft invoice INV-5520 created GBP 16,200  status:draft, missing SOW + VAT cert. link: https://finance.internal/INV-5520
Ibrahim (Sales): propose CC tokenization for month1 only. conditions: 1) buyer signs addendum 2) signed PO + VAT cert in 14 days 3) if docs not received, we issue credit and revert to PO billing for remaining term. legal ok?
Nora (Legal): ok with that. addendum will read: "Buyer agrees to deliver signed PO and VAT certificate within 14 calendar days of the first invoice. Failure to deliver permits Seller to suspend services or apply late PO fees." i'll post draft shortly.
Diego (Ops): ops checklist: [ ] signed PO (pdf) [ ] VAT cert (pdf) [ ] SOW (pdf) [ ] billing email confirmed. will flag account pending until items complete.
Clara (CS): timeline: if addendum + VAT cert arrive by Thu EOD, proceed with standard 9mo invoice; otherwise capture CC tomorrow for month1 and route addendum for signature. i'll update thread when docs land. :thumbsup:
